techniques.title: The 5-4-3-2-1 Grounding Technique
techniques.content:
This is a simple technique to help you ground yourself when you feel overwhelmed or anxious. It brings your focus to the present moment. Just notice:
- **5️⃣ Things You Can See:** Look around you and name five things you see.
- **4️⃣ Things You Can Feel:** Notice four things you can feel with your body.
- **3️⃣ Things You Can Hear:** Listen carefully and identify three sounds.
- **2️⃣ Things You Can Smell:** Notice two distinct smells.
- **1️⃣ Thing You Can Taste:** Bring your awareness to one thing you can taste.

techniques.title: The Importance of Journaling
techniques.content:
Writing down your thoughts and feelings can be incredibly therapeutic. It doesn't have to be structured or perfect. Journaling can help you:
- **Clarify your thoughts:** Untangle the worries in your mind by putting them on paper.
- **Recognize triggers:** By tracking your feelings, you can identify situations or thoughts that cause you stress.
- **Practice gratitude:** Regularly writing down what you're thankful for can shift your perspective towards positivity.
